verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs' own llms.txt explicitly states it offers official Python and Node.js SDKs alongside HTTP and WebSocket support, so the product directly provides official SDKs to build against Scribe. The evidence is a single summary line rather than in-depth SDK documentation. missing for 10: SDK reference docs or Scribe-specific SDK usage examples, coverage of the realtime/WebSocket path within the SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
